customer_acct: Hey team — our /rerank call started returning all zeros (scores = 0) after we moved our `query` down into each doc's `passages`. Example payload we sent:
```json
{
  "docs": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "passages": [{
        "text": "first chunk",
        "query": "what is the price"
      }]
    }
  ],
  "candidates": ["$A$", "$B$"]
}
```
We didn't get an error, just all-zero scores. Docs looked like they were indexed but scoring went flat. Any guidance?

jessica_cs: Thanks — can you paste the exact response body? was it a 422 or 200? Also which client/version are you using?

customer_acct: 200 OK with body like:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"candidate": "$A$", "score": 0},
    {"candidate": "$B$", "score": 0}
  ]
}
```
Client is our internal wrapper around the JS SDK (v1.3.0).

ryan_eng: Quick note — the rerank endpoint expects the `query` to be at the request root (or at the candidate level depending on mode). Putting `query` inside `passages` will be treated as opaque metadata currently and not used for scoring. That's why you're seeing zeros.

mina_ml: To add: passages are just document chunks. Scoring uses root `query` + `candidates` (or per-candidate `query` if you call that mode). We should update the docs example. Minimal curl that works for your payload shape:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"query":"what is the price","docs":[{"id":"d1","passages":[{"text":"first chunk"}]}],"candidates":["$A$","$B$"]}'
```
This returns non-zero scores for me.

deploy-bot: incidentbot: observed /rerank 200 OK; scoring latencies 210-450ms; fallback mapping not present.

jessica_cs: If you can't roll the client quickly, we can add a short-lived server-side fallback that checks `passages[*].query` and promotes the first seen `query` to the root when top-level `query` is missing. Want us to do that while you patch?

customer_acct: Yes please, that'd be great. Reduces risk while we update client.

ryan_eng: Opening a hotfix PR now — will add mapping for 48h fallback and a warning in logs when we see embedded `query`. PR #1234.

deploy-bot: deploy: roll/1234 started -> succeeded (canary + prod)

customer_acct: Just retried against prod after the deploy — scores are back to expected non-zero values. Thanks! :tada:

jessica_cs: I'll file a docs patch to clarify `query` placement and add an example for `passages` vs `candidates`. Also leaving an internal note about possibly accepting per-passage `query` in future if customers need per-chunk queries.

customer_acct: Great, :white_check_mark:. Closing on our side. Thanks everyone!
